original_test_intent: Exercise the exact BlueField InfiniBand/RDMA path with ib_write_bw for eight hours and prove sustained bandwidth plus HCA, link and system health meet the approved specification.
original_method: Pin perftest/rdma-core versions; map HCA/BDF/port/GID/peer/fabric; isolate workloads; define server/client roles and size/QP/depth/direction/reporting profile plus numeric floor/error limits; capture baseline; run 28,800 seconds with periodic samples; monitor port counters, HCA/system/thermal logs; stop on thresholds and restore.
manual_activity: IB owner supplies compatible peer/profile/SPEC and approves fabric isolation/window; operator ensures recovery; agent may run and monitor the exact approved verbs workload.
required_inputs: Pinned perftest/ib_write_bw and rdma-core versions/checksums on both endpoints
Isolation, alternate access, telemetry, abort and cleanup plan
safety_requirements: Do not substitute iperf or unspecified vendor tools
Verify compatible peer and GID/link layer
Stop on bandwidth, retry, port, HCA, thermal or access threshold; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and launch exact peer roles
Monitor full eight-hour RDMA and health evidence
Clean up and report without verdict
